title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Manager - Technical Bid & Solution**
======================================

**Role:**
=========

This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.

**Technical RFP Analysis**
==========================

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

**Solution Shaping**
====================

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

**Estimation & Delivery Planning**
==================================

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

**Technical Proposal Development**
==================================

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

**Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity**
==================================================

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

**Reusable Solution Assets**
============================

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**
=========================================

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

**The Personality We Are Looking For**
======================================

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Job Description: Technical Trainer

**Company:** Bytewave Technology  
**Job Location:** Visnagar, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (On-site)  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Hours:** 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM IST  
**Shift:** US Night Shift  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years preferred (candidates with strong technical knowledge and training skills may also apply)

About Bytewave Technology

Bytewave Technology is an IT staffing and recruitment company focused on the US and Canadian markets. We help candidates strengthen their technical knowledge, prepare for technical interviews, understand job requirements, and improve their readiness for career opportunities in the IT industry.

We are looking for a skilled and enthusiastic **Technical Trainer** who can train candidates in various programming languages and technologies while preparing them for real-world technical interviews and job opportunities.

Key Responsibilities1. Technical Training

* Train candidates in multiple programming languages and technologies, based on their background and learning requirements.
* Conduct training sessions in technologies such as:
* Java, Python, C#, and .NET
* JavaScript, React.js, Angular, and Node.js
* SQL, MySQL, and database concepts
* HTML, CSS, and web development fundamentals
* Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
* Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Cloud technologies such as AWS and Azure
* DevOps, Git, Docker, and CI/CD fundamentals
* Data Analytics, Power BI, and related technologies
* Explain technical concepts through practical examples, coding exercises, assignments, and real-world scenarios.
* Assess candidates' existing knowledge and create suitable learning plans.
* Track candidate progress and provide constructive feedback.

2. Mock Technical Interviews

* Conduct regular mock technical interview rounds.
* Prepare candidates for technical screening, coding rounds, and technical discussions.
* Ask relevant technical questions based on the candidate's resume, skills, experience, and target role.
* Evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, communication, and confidence.
* Provide detailed feedback and recommend areas for improvement.

3. Resume Understanding Sessions

* Help candidates understand every technical skill, project, tool, and technology mentioned in their resumes.
* Ensure candidates can confidently explain their projects, responsibilities, technical contributions, and work experience.
* Identify gaps between the candidate's actual knowledge and the skills listed on the resume.
* Guide candidates on presenting their technical experience accurately and professionally.
* Conduct resume-based question-and-answer practice sessions.

4. Job Description (JD) Understanding Sessions

* Explain job descriptions (JDs) to candidates in simple and practical terms.
* Help candidates understand required technical skills, responsibilities, qualifications, and experience.
* Map candidate skills against job requirements and identify learning gaps.
* Prepare candidates for the technologies and concepts commonly assessed for specific positions.
* Conduct JD-based interview preparation sessions.

5. Candidate Interview Preparation

* Prepare candidates for recruiter screening, technical interviews, and client interviews.
* Conduct technical question-and-answer practice sessions based on specific job requirements.
* Guide candidates on explaining projects, handling technical questions, and communicating clearly.
* Help candidates understand the interview process and professional interview etiquette.
* Coordinate with recruitment and career advisory teams to align preparation with relevant job opportunities.

6. Training Management & Reporting

* Prepare training schedules, lesson plans, assignments, and assessment materials.
* Maintain attendance records, training progress, assessment scores, and candidate feedback.
* Conduct periodic technical assessments and identify candidates who require additional support.
* Share daily or weekly training updates with the reporting manager.
* Collaborate with recruitment, career advisory, and sales teams to understand candidate requirements and upcoming interview needs.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Strong knowledge of one or more programming languages and software technologies.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to candidates with different experience levels.
* Practical understanding of software development, debugging, coding practices, and technical interview patterns.
* Experience conducting technical interviews, mock rounds, or structured training sessions.
* Strong communication, presentation, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prepare candidates based on resumes and specific job descriptions.
* Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple candidates and training sessions.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience as a Technical Trainer, Software Developer, Technical Interviewer, or Technical Mentor.
* Exposure to US IT staffing, recruitment, or client interview preparation.
* Familiarity with commonly requested US IT skills and job descriptions.
* Experience preparing freshers, experienced professionals, and career-transition candidates for technical interviews.
* Ability to train candidates across multiple technology domains, with deeper expertise in at least one core technology.

Performance Expectations

The Technical Trainer will be expected to:

* Deliver structured and effective technical training sessions.
* Improve candidates' technical understanding and interview readiness.
* Conduct regular mock interviews and provide actionable feedback.
* Ensure candidates understand the technical skills and projects listed on their resumes.
* Prepare candidates according to specific job descriptions and interview requirements.
* Maintain accurate training records and communicate progress to management.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
* Opportunity to work with candidates targeting US and Canadian IT opportunities.
* Professional development and exposure to multiple technical domains.
* Collaborative work environment with recruitment and career advisory teams.
* Opportunity to contribute to candidates' technical development and career growth.

title: Lead – Digital Transformation, AI & Business Automation
description:
Key Responsibilities

**A. Digital Transformation & ERP/CRM Integration**

* Design and execute the roadmap for LAXMI ONE, an integrated operating platform for the Group.
* Integrate existing applications such as Buildesk CRM, TallyPrime, Zoho People, WhatsApp, websites, and other approved platforms wherever technically and commercially practical.
* Develop APIs, middleware, database integrations, and automated data flows to establish a central source of truth.
* Reduce duplicate data entry, disconnected systems, manual reporting, and repetitive administrative work.
* Develop and implement modules progressively based on business priorities.

**B. Business Process Automation**

* Study existing workflows across departments and identify bottlenecks, manual activities, control gaps, and automation opportunities.
* Convert business policies into documented workflows, task assignments, approval matrices, checklists, deadlines, and escalation rules.
* Automate task allocation, reminders, approvals, follow-ups, reporting, and exception escalation.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and tracking for every critical business process.

**C. AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Implement suitable AI and LLM-based solutions for document processing, data analysis, reporting, business assistance, and workflow automation.
* Develop AI-assisted monitoring to identify delays, pending tasks, deviations, unusual transactions, and performance gaps.
* Build automated alerts and exception-based dashboards for management.
* Ensure human approval for sensitive decisions, financial transactions, legal matters, and other high-impact actions.
* Evaluate emerging AI tools and automation platforms for practical business use.

**D. Department-Wise Digital Systems**

Develop, integrate, or automate workflows across the following business functions:

* **Sales & Customer Management:** CRM, lead management, pre-sales, post-sales, customer/member records, booking, allotment, collections, demand letters, and possession.
* **Marketing:** Digital marketing workflows, campaign reporting, lead attribution, and performance dashboards.
* **Finance & Accounts:** TallyPrime integration, budgeting, billing, MIS, GST workflows, bank reconciliation, cash-flow monitoring, and project finance reporting.
* **Construction & Projects:** Project planning, construction timelines, bar charts, manpower planning, site expenses, labour attendance, productivity, quality, safety, and insurance tracking.
* **Purchase & Inventory:** Purchase requests, quotation comparison, approvals, inventory, material movement, and vendor management.
* **Contracts & Legal:** Contractor, architect, structural, MEP and consultant contracts; contract-linked billing; legal documentation; land records; title, valuation, agreements, and court-case tracking.
* **Compliance & Corporate Governance:** RERA, statutory compliance, Company Secretary workflows, Board and Committee meetings, Independent Director requirements, stock exchange and SEBI compliance tracking, as applicable.
* **HR & People Management:** Zoho People integration, attendance, employee records, designation, job descriptions, KPIs, targets, performance reviews, increments, promotions, rewards, training, and growth paths.
* **Hospitality & Member Services:** Member management, hospitality systems, mobile applications, and future e-commerce requirements.
* **Management Reporting:** Department-wise dashboards, project-wise performance, Group-level MIS, planning, and goal tracking.

**E. Workflow, Accountability & Control Framework**

Implement a standard workflow framework:

**Trigger → Task → Responsible Person → Deadline → Checklist → Evidence/Document → Approval → Completion → AI Review → Escalation → Dashboard**

Ensure that every employee and critical business activity can be mapped to the relevant designation, job description, authority, reporting manager, KPI, target, tasks, deadlines, achievements, pending work, training, and growth path.

**F. Dashboards, MIS & Planning**

* Develop real-time or scheduled dashboards for management and department heads.
* Establish exception-based reporting instead of depending on manual follow-ups.
* Support weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, 3-year, 5-year, and 10-year planning and goal tracking.
* Define data ownership, validation rules, audit trails, and reporting standards.

**G. Data Security & System Governance**

* Implement role-based access control, data privacy, backup, recovery, and cybersecurity practices.
* Maintain reliable records, integration logs, and audit trails.
* Ensure secure handling of employee, customer, financial, legal, and confidential business data.
* Document system architecture, APIs, workflows, configurations, and technical processes.

3. Required Technical Skills

* Strong practical experience in full-stack development and business application development.
* Hands-on knowledge of relational databases, data modelling, SQL, and database architecture.
* Experience developing and integrating REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party applications.
* Understanding of ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms, workflow engines, and enterprise application architecture.
* Experience with workflow automation, dashboards, reporting, and business intelligence.
* Practical exposure to AI/LLM integration, AI APIs, prompt engineering, and intelligent automation.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, role-based access, data security, and application deployment.
* Ability to evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and work with existing platforms wherever appropriate.
* Familiarity with Git, testing, documentation, deployment, and application maintenance.

4. Candidate Profile

* Approximately 5–8 years of relevant hands-on experience in software development, enterprise applications, ERP/CRM, SaaS, business automation, or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated experience building or substantially developing real-world systems and integrations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with a business-process-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work directly with management, HR, Finance, Sales, Projects, Purchase, Legal, and other departments.

Candidates with only website development, basic IT support, or theoretical AI knowledge without practical system-building experience may not be suitable.

Performance will be evaluated against agreed implementation milestones, including:

* Successful integration of prioritized existing applications.

Specific targets and timelines will be finalized with management after assessing the current technology environment and implementation priorities.

description:
**Job Title:** **Video Editor (AI Video Generation)**

**Shift Time:** 7:00 am to 4 :30 pm

**Experience Required:** 2.5–4 years in video editing, ideally for social media or an agency

**About the role**

We are hiring a full-time video editor who makes scroll-stopping social videos and uses AI video tools as part of everyday work. You will edit Reels, Shorts and TikToks, build paid ad creatives for Meta and Google, and produce brand and promo videos for our clients.

This role suits someone who edits fast, understands what makes people stop scrolling in the first 3 seconds, and enjoys testing new AI tools to produce more variations in less time.

**Key responsibilities**

**Short-form social content**

* Edit 15–90 second Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikToks in vertical 9:16 format
* Add trending-style captions, text animations, sound design, transitions and music
* Write or adapt hooks so the first 3 seconds grab attention
* Repurpose long videos, podcasts and client footage into multiple short clips

**Paid ad creatives (Meta and Google)**

* Produce video ads in all key ratios: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9
* Create 3–5 variations per ad (different hooks, CTAs, music) for A/B testing
* Work with the ads team to read performance data and improve the next round of creatives
* Follow each platform's ad specs, safe zones and policy rules

**Brand and promo videos**

* Edit product launches, service explainers, testimonials and company promos
* Keep every video on-brand: fonts, colours, logo use and tone of voice
* Add motion graphics, lower thirds and simple 2D animations where needed

**AI video generation**

* Generate B-roll, product scenes and visual concepts with AI video tools
* Create AI voiceovers and avatar-based videos when real footage is not available
* Use AI for faster work: auto-captions, background removal, upscaling, clip selection
* Write clear prompts and keep a shared prompt library for the team
* Check all AI output for quality, brand fit and usage rights before delivery

**Workflow**

* Manage 15–25 edits per week across multiple clients without missing deadlines
* Handle feedback rounds and keep project files organised and named properly
* Keep up with social trends, formats and new AI tools, and share what works

**Required skills and experience**

* 2.5–4 years of professional video editing, with a strong portfolio of social media videos
* Hands-on experience with at least two AI video generation tools, with real samples to show
* Strong sense of pacing, rhythm, storytelling and hooks for short-form video
* Good knowledge of colour correction, audio cleanup and sound design
* Basic motion graphics and text animation skills
* Understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Meta ad formats and best practices
* Able to take feedback well and turn around revisions quickly
* Good written English for captions, prompts and client communication

**Nice to have**

* Agency experience handling several brands at once
* Experience making video for Australian, US or UK clients
* Basic shooting skills on phone or camera, including lighting and framing
* Knowledge of UGC-style ads and creator-style editing
* Basic Photoshop or Illustrator for thumbnails and covers
